<thought>To propose a one‑step retrosynthesis, I will look for a template that forms an ester (the target contains a methyl ester). The most common disconnection is the ester‑forming reaction between a carboxylic acid (or its activated derivative) and methanol. I will search the template catalog for a forward reaction that creates an ester from a carboxylic acid and an alcohol.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
  "functional_groups_formed": ["ester"],
  "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic_acid", "alcohol"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
